mapper.sql: id, user_profile, weak_points, evidence_count, question_count, total_score, status, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quick_review_paper ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quick_review_paper ( user_profile, weak_points, evidence_count, question_count, total_score, status, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userProfile}, #{weakPoints}, #{evidenceCount}, #{questionCount}, #{totalScore}, #{status}, #{submittedAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE quick_review_paper SET total_score = #{totalScore}, status = #{status}, submitted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
